proposals.prompt:
Agents in a supermarket gridworld must collect their required items and leave through the exit. Every action costs the same, so demonstrators prefer short trajectories -- unless an unknown social norm makes them behave otherwise. Your task is to propose candidate norms (obligations or prohibitions) that could explain the demonstrated behaviour.
Each demonstration is listed step by step as  `k: {atoms true in the state} action`.

Available atoms:
- at(x,y) -- the agent is at cell (x,y); x = column (0 = left), y = row (0 = top); N decreases y, S increases y, E increases x, W decreases x
- hasCart -- the agent is holding/pushing a shopping cart
- actions N, S, E, W, MOVE (any of the four moves), INTERACT (any interaction with an object: the different kinds of interaction are NOT distinguished), EXIT (leave the store; always the last action)

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,
 "abstraction": {"state_properties": {name: FORMULA, ...},
                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}
         | {"or": [F, ...]} | {"le"|"lt"|"ge"|"gt"|"eq": [numeric_feature, integer]}
Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: A shopper is obliged to pick up a cart at the start of the trip and keep shopping as a cart user.
A shopper is forbidden to leave the store without the cart they used during the trip.
Carts are forbidden in single-file aisles, identified as cells whose horizontal free width is only one cell.
A shopper is forbidden to push a cart from an open aisle into a single-file aisle.
When a cart user reaches the mouth of the single-file shelf aisle, they are obliged to park the cart there before proceeding on foot.

Output format: return ONLY a JSON list (no prose, no code fences). Each element:
{"id": short_name, "text": one-sentence natural-language statement of the norm,

                 "events": {name: {"pre": FORMULA, "post": FORMULA or null}, ...}},
 "norm": {"type": "prohibition", "condition": FORMULA}
       | {"type": "obligation", "trigger": FORMULA or "START", "discharge": FORMULA}}
FORMULA := atom | name of a property/event defined in this hypothesis | {"not": F} | {"and": [F, ...]}

Semantics.  A trajectory is a sequence of steps (state s_k, action a_k).  A step's label contains the atoms true in
s_k and the action a_k.  A state property is a formula over state atoms (no actions).  An event
{"pre": P, "post": Q} occurs at step k when P holds for the label of step k and Q holds in the next state s_{k+1}
(post may be null).  A prohibition counts one violation for every step whose label (including events occurring at
that step) satisfies the condition.  An obligation becomes pending at any step satisfying the trigger ("START" =
pending from the beginning) and is fulfilled by a later (or the same) step satisfying the discharge; it can be
triggered again; it is violated if it is still pending when the trajectory ends.

parsed.text: A shopper is obliged to pick up a cart at the start of the trip and keep shopping as a cart user.
A shopper is forbidden to leave the store without the cart they used during the trip.
Carts are forbidden in single-file aisles, identified as cells whose horizontal free width is only one cell.
A shopper is forbidden to push a cart from an open aisle into a single-file aisle.
When a cart user reaches the mouth of the single-file shelf aisle, they are obliged to park the cart there before proceeding on foot.
After parking a cart to enter a single-file aisle, the shopper is obliged to retrieve that cart before leaving the store.
In two-wide shelf bays, shoppers are forbidden to be without a cart, distinguishing them from one-wide aisles where carts do not fit.
A shopper is forbidden to detach or park a cart in a constricted place; cart parking should occur only in broad open aisles.

accepted.description: [g1_must_take_entry_cart] OBLIGED: after start, eventually pickUpCart (before exit)  where entranceCartArea := (at(1,7) ∧ freeWidthH≥6 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); pickUpCart := (entranceCartArea ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart
[g1_no_cart_in_single_file_aisle] FORBIDDEN: cartInSingleFileAisle  where cartInSingleFileAisle := (singleFileAisle ∧ hasCart); singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1

[g1_no_push_cart_into_single_file] FORBIDDEN: pushCartIntoSingleFileAisle  where openAisle := freeWidthH≥6; singleFileAisle := freeWidthH≤1; pushCartIntoSingleFileAisle := (openAisle ∧ hasCart ∧ MOVE) · (singleFileAisle ∧ hasCart)

[g1_park_cart_at_single_file_mouth] OBLIGED: after atSingleFileMouthWithCart, eventually parkCartAtSingleFileMouth (before exit)  where atSingleFileMouthWithCart := (singleFileMouth ∧ hasCart); singleFileMouth := (at(6,3) ∧ freeWidthH≥6 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); parkCartAtSingleFileMouth := (singleFileMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart

[g1_retrieve_cart_after_single_file] OBLIGED: after parkCartAtSingleFileMouth, eventually retrieveCartAtSingleFileMouth (before exit)  where singleFileMouth := (at(6,3) ∧ freeWidthH≥6 ∧ freeWidthV≥5); parkCartAtSingleFileMouth := (singleFileMouth ∧ hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart; retrieveCartAtSingleFileMouth := (singleFileMouth ∧ ¬hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · hasCart

[g1_cart_required_in_two_wide_shelf_bay] FORBIDDEN: cartlessInTwoWideShelfBay  where cartlessInTwoWideShelfBay := (twoWideShelfBay ∧ ¬hasCart); twoWideAisle := freeWidthH=2; twoWideShelfBay := (twoWideAisle ∧ adjShelf)

[g1_do_not_detach_cart_in_constricted_place] FORBIDDEN: (detachCart ∧ constrictedPlace)  where constrictedPlace := (horizontallyConstricted ∨ verticallyConstricted); horizontallyConstricted := freeWidthH≤2; verticallyConstricted := freeWidthV≤2; detachCart := (hasCart ∧ INTERACT) · ¬hasCart
